newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks soar, index tops 14,500 in late trade.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks soar, index tops 14,500 in late trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks extended their gains on Thursday afternoon with the Hang Seng Index climbing 303 points, or 2.13 percent, to 14,507 on the strength of property counters.

"Property stocks rebounded with investors believing that the govenment might not implement overly severe measures that may hit the property market," said Percy Au-Young, reseach director at DBS Securities.
Sun Hung Kai Properties climbed HK$4.00 to HK$91.00 and Henderson Land added HK$3.75 at HK$68.50.
"A sharp surge on Hongkong Telecom also helped the index," he added.
Hongkong Telecom soared HK$0.80 to HK$17.55 on optimism it would benefit from good traffic growth between Hong Kong and China after Beijing cut prices on long-distance calls.
